items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: The interviewer refers to 'The guy' (likely Leroy Evans based on context), but the interviewee does not explicitly confirm a personal relationship or specific interaction with 'The guy' beyond the general statement 'We all worked together' which refers to Leroy Evans and others, not necessarily 'The

ctx.x: Yeah, well, Leroy Evans was just the same way. Mm-hmm. Dead explosions and everything like that. We all worked together. Mm-hmm. And, when Chris would get that rubber stuff and put it in that cornet, he didn't play no trumpets. That little cornet. Mm-hmm.
The guy could pull up from that.
Mm-hmm. Put that prime back to Jamaica, Callous Love, and uh, DMF, you know what that is. Boy, he'd blow that.
